duration: Camp volunteers help during the summer. Other roles are ongoing.
name: Lyman Woods Volunteers (camp and program helpers, ages 14 and up)
what_you_do: Help the camp counselor and campers with games, crafts and hikes at Lyman Woods. You can also help at after-school and special programs. Other roles are restoration and garden work. There is also an office role at the interpretive center.
who_can_apply: Camp volunteers and general program volunteers must be at least 14 years old. Other roles do not list an age on the page. Everyone fills out a volunteer waiver. The page says teens to seniors can volunteer.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Call 630-963-9388 for Lyman Woods volunteer details.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Lyman Woods application for the role you want. Also fill out the volunteer waiver. Program and camp volunteers send in an application and go to an interview and training. A criminal background check is only for program volunteers 18 or older.
notes: REAP restoration workdays need an RSVP. The park district also runs Counselor in Training (C.I.T.) camps for teens. They have a sign-up fee. The pages read did not list ages or the fee amount.
